description_en: Binds multiple certificates to an HTTPS listener of a Global Accelerator instance. Combined with virtual endpoint groups and forwarding rules, this enables accelerated access to multiple HTTPS domain names. You can call the AssociateAdditionalCertificatesWithListener operation to bind additional certificates to an HTTPS listener
description_zh: 为全球加速HTTPS协议监听绑定多个证书，并结合虚拟终端节点组和转发策略功能，可实现加速访问多个HTTPS域名。您可以调用AssociateAdditionalCertificatesWithListener接口为HTTPS监听绑定扩展证书
kebab_example: aliyun ga associate-additional-certificates-with-listener --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --accelerator-id ga-bp1odcab8tmno0hdq0000 --listener-id lsr-bp1bpn0kn908w4nbw0000 --certificates Id=609200-cn-hangzhou Domain=example.com --region cn-hangzhou
name: AssociateAdditionalCertificatesWithListener

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance. Set the value to cn-hangzhou
parameters.help_zh: 全球加速实例所在的地域ID，仅取值cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a parameter value from your client to ensure uniqueness across different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request is different
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA)
parameters.name: accelerator_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the listener. Only HTTPS listeners are supported
parameters.help_zh: 监听实例ID。仅支持HTTPS的监听
parameters.name: listener_id

fields.help_en:
The domain name for which the certificate takes effect. Each domain name can be bound to only one additional certificate.

You can specify up to 10 domain names at a time
fields.help_zh:
证书指定生效的域名。一个域名只能绑定一个扩展证书。

一次最多支持输入10个域名
fields.name: domain

fields.help_en:
The certificate ID. Only server certificates are supported.

You can specify up to 10 certificate IDs at a time
fields.help_zh:
证书ID，当前仅支持服务器证书。

一次最多支持输入10个证书ID
fields.name: id

parameters.help_en:
The list of additional certificates.

You can specify up to 10 certificates at a time
parameters.help_zh:
扩展证书列表。

一次最多支持输入10个证书信息
parameters.name: certificates
